languages.name: Tibetan
languages.pronunciation: Wylie: gnam lcags ’bar ba; Tibetan pinyin: Namjagbarwa

languages.name: English / Romanized form

gloss.en: A proper name for the 7,782-metre mountain in Nyingchi, Tibet Autonomous Region, at the eastern end of the Himalayas.
gloss.zh-Hans: 西藏自治区林芝市境内、喜马拉雅山脉东端一座海拔 7782 米山峰的专名。

meaning.en: Named-entity correspondence, not an ordinary lexical translation. Tibetan གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ། (gnam lcags ’bar ba) can be read lexically as ‘blazing sky-iron / meteorite’ or, with gnam lcags understood as lightning, ‘blazing lightning.’ The Chinese 南迦巴瓦 is a sound-based transcription, not a semantic translation.
meaning.zh-Hans: 这是专名形式对应，不是普通词汇翻译。藏文 གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།（gnam lcags ’bar ba）按词面可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的天铁（陨铁）”，若把 gnam lcags 取“雷电／霹雳”义，则可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的雷电”。汉语“南迦巴瓦”属于音译，不是意译。

rationale.en: The Romanized and Chinese forms identify the same place. Name-meaning reports are kept as separate, attributed evidence items and are not converted into a phonetic-semantic candidate.
rationale.zh-Hans: 罗马字母形式与汉字形式指向同一地点。名称释义按来源拆分为独立证据项，不转化为语音—语义候选。

orthography_note.en: Tibet Daily's Tibetan-language site, the Rangjung Yeshe place entry and Kyoto University's academic Tibet map use gnam without a final s. Some secondary web sources print གནམས / gnams; this entry adopts the better-attested གནམ / gnam form and records the variant without treating it as primary.
orthography_note.zh-Hans: 西藏日报藏文网站、Rangjung Yeshe 地名条目及京都大学学术地图均采用不带词尾 s 的 གནམ / gnam。部分二手网页写作 གནམས / gnams；本条采用证据更充分的 གནམ / gnam，同时记录该异写，不将其作为主写法。

meaning.en: sky-iron / meteoric iron; also thunderbolt or lightning
meaning.zh-Hans: 天铁／陨铁；亦可指霹雳、雷电

meaning.en: to blaze, burn, shine or glow

assessment.en: 南迦巴瓦 approximately follows the sound sequence Nam-jag-bar-wa; 峰 adds the Chinese geographic classifier ‘peak.’ The individual Chinese character meanings are not a translation of the Tibetan morphemes.
assessment.zh-Hans: “南迦巴瓦”大体按 Nam-jag-bar-wa 的音节转写，“峰”补出汉语地理类别。南、迦、巴、瓦各字的汉语字义不用于翻译藏文词素。

analysis.en: Closest among the published Chinese explanations when gnam lcags is read as lightning and ’bar ba as blazing/burning. ‘如火’ is explanatory rather than a separate Tibetan morpheme.
analysis.zh-Hans: 在公开汉语解释中最接近藏文结构：gnam lcags 可取“雷电”，’bar ba 可取“燃烧／闪耀”。其中“如火”是汉语说明性补充，并非另有一个对应藏文词素。

analysis.en: A direct compositional rendering of gnam ‘sky’ + lcags ‘iron/metal’ + ’bar ba ‘blaze/burn/shine.’ Princeton's Dictionary of Buddhism similarly gives ‘Blazing Meteor.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 按 gnam“天”＋lcags“铁／金属”＋’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”组合出的较直接译法。《普林斯顿佛教辞典》亦将整词释作“Blazing Meteor（燃烧的流星／陨星）”。

translation_assessments.chinese: 直刺蓝天的战矛／直刺天空的长矛

analysis.en: The Tibetan written form contains no separately identifiable morpheme for spear, battle or piercing. This is best labelled an image associated with the mountain's shape and the Gesar epic tradition, not a literal translation.
analysis.zh-Hans: 藏文词面中没有可分别对应“长矛／战矛”“刺入”的词素。较合理的身份是结合山形与《格萨尔王传》传统形成的形象化文化解释，而非直译。

analysis.en: It reflects the ‘sky-iron / meteorite’ sense of gnam lcags, but changes iron/metal to stone and omits ’bar ba ‘blazing.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 它抓住了 gnam lcags“天铁／陨铁”的来源意象，但把“铁／金属”泛化为“石头”，并省略了 ’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”。

analysis.en: An attested honorific epithet. The written name contains no morpheme meaning mountain, many/all, or father, so it is not a translation of the name.
analysis.zh-Hans: 这是有资料记录的尊称。藏文名称中没有“山”“众”“父”对应词素，因此不是山名字面翻译。

summary.en: Authoritative and institutional sources agree on the place identity and commonly report 7,782 metres, but published explanations of the Tibetan name vary and do not establish one exclusive etymology here.
summary.zh-Hans: 权威及机构来源对地点身份一致，并普遍采用海拔 7782 米；但公开资料对藏语名称的解释不一，本词条不据此确立唯一词源。

claim.en: Tibetan-language and academic geographic sources record the name as གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།, Wylie gnam lcags ’bar ba.
claim.zh-Hans: 藏文媒体与学术地名资料将名称写作 གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།，威利转写为 gnam lcags ’bar ba。

claim.en: Dictionary evidence supports gnam ‘sky,’ gnam lcags ‘meteoric iron / thunderbolt / lightning,’ and ’bar ba ‘blaze, burn, shine,’ making ‘blazing sky-iron / meteor’ or ‘blazing lightning’ the closest lexical analyses.
claim.zh-Hans: 词典证据支持 gnam“天空”、gnam lcags“陨铁／霹雳／雷电”、’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”，因此“燃烧的天铁／陨星”或“燃烧的雷电”是更贴近词面的分析。

claim.en: A Tibet Autonomous Region government page reports the name as meaning ‘a battle spear piercing the blue sky.’
claim.zh-Hans: 西藏自治区人民政府页面将名称释为“直刺蓝天的战矛”。

claim.en: China Tibet Online reports multiple explanations: ‘lightning burning like fire’ and ‘a long spear piercing the sky’; it connects the latter image with the ‘Battle of Menling’ in the Epic of King Gesar.
claim.zh-Hans: 中国西藏网明确称其藏语有多种解释：一为“雷电如火燃烧”，一为“直刺天空的长矛”；后者与《格萨尔王传》“门岭一战”的长矛意象相连。

claim.en: The Nyingchi municipal government identifies Namcha Barwa as a 7,782-metre mountain at the eastern end of the Himalayas and the highest mountain in Nyingchi.
claim.zh-Hans: 林芝市人民政府资料记载：南迦巴瓦峰海拔 7782 米，位于喜马拉雅山脉东端，是林芝市最高山峰。

claim.en: A Chinese Academy of Sciences science-communication article records ‘father of mountains’ as a Tibetan epithet alongside the spear-like image; it is treated as an epithet, not a literal decomposition of the name.
claim.zh-Hans: 中国科学院科普文章在“刺向苍穹的利矛”意象之外，记录其藏语称谓“众山之父”；本词条将其视为称谓，不作为名称字面拆解。

summary.en: This entry records forms of one proper name; it makes no cross-language phonetic-semantic candidate claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 本词条记录同一专名的不同形式，不提出跨语言语音—语义候选。

summary.en: Cloud veil, youthful face, forest, lake and song are literary images created by the author around the named place.
summary.zh-Hans: 云的面纱、青春容颜、森林、湖与歌声是作者围绕该地点专名展开的文学意象。

summary.en: No new etymological, phonetic or historical-origin hypothesis is proposed.
summary.zh-Hans: 不提出新的词源、语音或历史起源假说。

proposition.en: Namcha Barwa, may you keep your countenance.
proposition.zh-Hans: 南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜。

text.zh-Hans: 在花园里，水仙、迎春、春兰、杜鹃花、牡丹、月季，她们同时在春天盛开。和风吹在我的花园内，吹动着花的香气。

essay_prose.status: Published; punctuation and one traditional character normalized

title.en: Namcha Barwa, May You Keep Your Countenance
title.zh-Hans: 南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜

text.zh-Hans:
看过南迦巴瓦山的一些照片，很喜欢西藏这个藏在漫漫群山中的秀丽山峰。

南迦巴瓦山啊，
你是我的心里的少男少女，
是我自己心里的透出熏香味的向往，
还是我自己那少年时代的持续？
那美丽是就像我看到那青春的照片，
那是少年时代的情绪的青涩，
那不正是你的青春似的树🌳与湖吗？
有愿望的我想保持一颗爱你的心💕，
因为我的爱你的光芒，
将使你的青春的面容总是清秀。

你轻柔的云的面纱，
你貌似的对我发出尊重的话语，
可是我却总是希望撕下，
你的优雅的话语所包围的遮幕，
总是想看到你的真容，
在走进你心底的森林的深处，
我却晓得了你的柔美的如丽水般，
流淌的心如歌声的，
在与你温煦话语的对话，
与你激烈的对抗中，
我却对你产生了从我的心底，
流出的一种爱意。

poem_lyrics.status: Published; lineation preserved; obvious typo 情青 normalized to 青春

evidence_boundary.en: The garden, youth, face, veil, forest, lake, fragrance and love are the author's literary layer. They do not establish the mountain name's etymology or geographic facts.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 花园、青春、容颜、面纱、森林、湖、香气与爱意均属作者文学层，不用于确立山名词源或地理事实。
